title: Natural strict-system assembly of ordinary open tensor comparisons
statement: Fix independent site and coefficient universes, a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, an open immersion j:U→X and section-normalized operations o [def-sf-integral-open-operations]. Let AX and AU be the supplied ordinary reduction models [def-sf-open-semilinear-tensor-model-data], with their finite evaluations and quotient squares, and let tensor be a generator-normalized TensorComparison. There is a natural isomorphism r:extension⋙AX.functor≅AU.functor⋙systemExtension. For every module M and level n, evaluation(n)(r_M) equals scalarLevelComparison(o,AX,AU,tensor,n)_M. This is extension tensor assembly only; no geometric restriction mate or its invertibility is asserted.

source.place: Tags 03DJ and 0E8I, with sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0941: compatible ordinary coefficient tensor comparisons.

proof.text: The repaired restrictionSections field supplies exactly the hrestriction hypothesis of openScalarTransitionCompatibility. The normalized finite scalarLevelComparison components therefore commute with every coefficient transition.
Apply the proved naturalIsoOfEvaluation_exists to these compatible finite isomorphisms. Its prescribed evaluations are exactly the required scalarLevelComparison components.

proof_origin.place: Ordinary extension part of the open-factor compatibility; existing scalar transition comparison followed by natural system assembly.

mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits include NatIso.ofComponents and its component equations. This supplies the final natural-isomorphism constructor; objectwise semilinear assembly and joint faithfulness of coefficient evaluations still need the project lemma and proof.
Twelve hits: NatIso.ofComponents, app, hom_app, inv_app and uses in equivalences. Used NatIso.ofComponents, but no result assembles compatible semilinear evaluations naturally.

Twenty-five hits showing NatIso.ofComponents constructions in ordinary functor categories. Local source supplies systemIsoOfEvaluation_exists; the new proof adds naturality by sectionwise faithfulness.

from.place: Natural ordinary extension tensor assembly, before the restriction mate calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryExtensionTensorAssembly
    (AX : OpenSemilinearTensor.OrdinaryReduction l E X)
    (AU : OpenSemilinearTensor.OrdinaryReduction l E U)
    (tensor : TensorComparison l E j o) :
    ∃ r : extension l E j o ⋙ AX.functor ≅ AU.functor ⋙ systemExtension l E j o,
      ∀ M n, (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n).map (r.hom.app M) =
        (OpenSemilinearTensor.scalarLevelComparison l E j o AX AU tensor n).hom.app M
